title: Production Management I
modules: The Nature And Scope Of Production

mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a weight measurement commonly used in the industry, while Metre is a unit for length measurement."
Tonne is a weight measurement commonly used in the industry, while Metre is a unit for length measurement.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method used by management to satisfy conflicting demands such as customer satisfaction versus efficient utilization of resources."
Work design is a method used by management to satisfy conflicting demands such as customer satisfaction versus efficient utilization of resources.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the techniques used in Work Study."
Method Study is one of the techniques used in Work Study.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that the job will be completed at less time than assigned, hence a reduction in Cycle Time."
A higher standard performance means that the job will be completed at less time than assigned, hence a reduction in Cycle Time.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the actual processing time plus unloading and other allowances for personnel and other needs while standard performance is standard time required to perform a task."
Cycle Time refers to the actual processing time plus unloading and other allowances for personnel and other needs while standard performance is standard time required to perform a task.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the creation of goods and services for marketing and to meet the needs of consumers."
Production is concerned with the creation of goods and services for marketing and to meet the needs of consumers.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the arrangement of machines, offices, equipments, light and electrical outlets, store rooms and all other facilities in the plant or office."
Factory Layout is the arrangement of machines, offices, equipments, light and electrical outlets, store rooms and all other facilities in the plant or office.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a key aspect of production that requires careful consideration in order to ensure cost effectiveness. 24 5.0."
Factory location is a key aspect of production that requires careful consideration in order to ensure cost effectiveness. 24 5.0.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a key aspect of the production system."
System operation is a key aspect of the production system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a non-continuous and repetitive production."
Batch production is a non-continuous and repetitive production.
